name: Sonangol
desc: Angola's state-owned oil and gas group covering exploration, production, refining, fuel distribution, trading and shipping.
products: crude oil, natural gas, refined fuels, trading and shipping
customers: oil buyers, Angolan fuel consumers and businesses
markets: Angola; offices or operations in Singapore, UK, USA, Brazil, Iraq, DR Congo, Cape Verde, São Tomé and Príncipe

signals.what: 2025 annual report and accounts published; first-half 2025 management report published; Sonangol 2023-2028 bond coupon notice (no new event of note)

fit_rationale: Large African national oil company with trading arms in Singapore, London and Houston; hospitality could serve trading counterparties, but no Grand Prix in Angola, governance history weighs on brand, and the fuel category is crowded.

compliance: Wikipedia records historic bribery and embezzlement cases: 2020 Swiss court finding of bribes to Sonangol officials (2005-2008); former chair Isabel dos Santos convicted in June 2023 of embezzling EUR 52.6m; 2021 bribery charge against a former Sonangol Distribuidora CEO linked to Trafigura. Needs compliance review before approach.
outstanding: Profitability; status of the partial privatisation/IPO; current marketing structure; compliance clearance.

name: Spirit of Tasmania
desc: Tasmanian government-owned company running the overnight Bass Strait passenger and vehicle ferries between Geelong and Devonport.
products: passenger and vehicle ferry service, freight
parent_backing: November 2025: Treasurer Eric Abetz guaranteed government support for the company's debts (Wikipedia)
stores_or_sites: two new 48,000 GT ships (Spirit of Tasmania IV and V)
qualifying_metric: revenue (FY2018, older than three years); also state backing
profitability_basis: profitable in FY2018 (A$44.4m net income) but no recent figure
distress: Tasmanian Auditor-General assessed the company insolvent as of August 2025 and referred the board to ASIC (November 2025); chairman disputed it; wharf cost overruns from $90m to $495m

signals.what: New ships Spirit of Tasmania IV and V began commercial operation from new Spirit Quay berth
Auditor-General insolvency finding; state guarantee of debts

fit_rationale: Single-route state ferry operator in financial difficulty whose market is Tasmanian tourism; Melbourne is near Geelong but there is no case for an F1 budget.
